summary: Iteration 19 validated 4 new features end-to-end: (1) Express order → Stripe checkout with order-currency support (EUR/MAD), (2) auto_assign_order using origin_lat/origin_lng for express orders, (3) Admin Cities CRUD with all guardrails (403 for non-admin, 400 on duplicate, 400 on delete-with-active-order, 200 on clean delete), (4) Business bank_account (IBAN) persistence on POST /api/businesses. Backend pytest 10/10 + 1 skipped (replaced by direct DB unit test that PASSED). Frontend CityManager CRUD works flawlessly; express banner click triggers POST /api/orders/express (200) → POST /api/payments/create-checkout (200) → real redirect to checkout.stripe.com showing €12.50 EUR; business-bank-input renders in BusinessDashboard dialog and IBAN reaches the backend (toast 'Negocio creado exitosamente' shown).

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' (accessibility, low priority)

action_items: Optional: add aria-describedby/DialogDescription inside CityManager edit dialog to remove Radix accessibility warning.

Optional: housekeeping — there are leftover TEST_Del_* cities in the production cities collection from the 'delete-with-active-order' test (the rule correctly blocked deletion). The active orders blocking them are TEST express orders with status=pending. Either cancel those orders or run a one-shot cleanup script if a clean DB is desired.
Optional: expose an admin endpoint (e.g. POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/mark-paid) to enable end-to-end paid-order tests without invoking real Stripe; today this had to be simulated via direct DB write.
critical_code_review_comments: create_checkout_session line 936 correctly derives currency from order ('eur' default, lowercase) — verified by creating EUR and MAD express orders; both returned a Stripe session url.

auto_assign_order lines 743-744 use origin_lat/origin_lng for order_type=='express' and fall back to city centre otherwise — verified by direct DB test: a paid express order with city_id=null and origin at Madrid centre was auto-assigned to bee.madrid in <2s.

admin_create_city/admin_update_city/admin_delete_city all guard with role=='admin' (403 otherwise), reject duplicate names (400), and block deletion when active orders reference city_id (count of orders with status NOT IN delivered/cancelled). All four guardrails verified.

Business model + BusinessCreate include Optional[str] bank_account; create_business persists it as-is via model_dump(); GET /api/businesses returns it. No PII validation/masking — acceptable for MVP but consider IBAN format validation server-side.

CustomerDashboard.placeExpressOrder now: POST /api/orders/express → POST /api/payments/create-checkout?order_id=... → window.location.href = url. Verified with real network calls and real navigation to checkout.stripe.com — Stripe rendered the page with the correct €12.50 EUR amount.
CityManager.jsx: solid component — add/edit/delete buttons all use data-testid attributes correctly, city-count updates reactively, edit dialog and delete AlertDialog are properly scoped.
Minor: BusinessDashboard category Select uses Radix; works but adds accessibility warnings on the create dialog (missing DialogDescription).
Minor: no logging when a customer references a non-existent origin_city_id in create_express_order (city_name silently becomes null).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features for iteration 19 are operational. Backend regression suites live at /app/backend/tests/ — run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_nubo_iter19.py -v. The direct auto-assign script (test_auto_assign_express_direct.py) needs MONGO_URL and DB_NAME from backend/.env.
